create_skinned_mesh: create a SkinnedMesh instance from an actor and model with GPU skinning support
update_skinned_mesh_bone_matrices: update the SkinnedMesh bone matrices by calling Update to apply current skinning transforms
set_skinned_mesh_color: set the SkinnedMesh display color by calling SetColor which re-registers the model
register_skinned_mesh: register the SkinnedMesh models with the RenderPipeline for rendering in the scene
create_texture_from_image: create a raylib texture from a PIL image using the _create_texture_from_image helper function
